name: Metric sandwich
goal: {{task}} Done when `{{test-command}}` passes and a critic finds nothing unmet in {{checklist}}.

template.title: Metric sandwich
template.summary: Cheap deterministic checks run first; an expensive critic judges only what they cannot see, and either failure returns to the builder.
template.whenToUse: Cheap deterministic checks first, expensive judgment only on what those cannot see: lint and tests catch most failures, and a reviewer should not spend a round on them.
template.notFor: Work with no deterministic check to run first (use review-gate), or where the checks are the whole story (use grind-loop).

slots.ask: What should be built or changed? One or two sentences a builder can act on.
slots.example: Add a slugify(text) function to src/strings.ts that lowercases, strips accents and joins words with single hyphens.

slots.ask: Which file holds the checklist the critic judges against?

description: A builder works; a check runs the cheap deterministic suite. Only a passing change reaches the frontier critic, which judges what the suite cannot see against a checklist. Either failing returns to the builder, so one loop has two back edges. It stops when the critic passes, at its round cap, or at its turn budget.

nodes.name: Builder
nodes.brief: Do the task in the code, with tests. On a later round you get either the failing check output or REVIEW.md; address what it names. Run `{{test-command}}` before you report.
inputs: check output or REVIEW.md (from round 1 on)

nodes.name: Critic
nodes.brief: Judge only what `{{test-command}}` cannot see, the items in the checklist, for a change that already passes it; use the repository only to understand what the change touches. Do not rerun or restate the checks. Cite the file and line for each finding; you judge, you do not fix. Verdict pass when no checklist item is unmet.
inputs: the repository at the head commit, read-only
outputs: REVIEW.md: findings by checklist item and a verdict line

evidence: the repository at the head commit, read-only

bar.name: Checks, then checklist
bar.acceptance: `{{test-command}}` exits 0 and the critic finds no unmet item in {{checklist}}.
